# Map Shows Only Three States That Approve of Donald Trump

Published

Aug 17, 2026 at 02:18 PM EDT

updated

Aug 17, 2026 at 02:19 PM EDT

Jordan King

Reporter

President Donald Trump’s approval rating is underwater in all but Idaho, West Virginia and Wyoming, according to new estimates.

Wyoming has the highest net approval of the three (+14), followed by Idaho (+9) and West Virginia (+6), according to The Economist’s most recent projections, using polling data from YouGov. [...] Net approval is calculated by subtracting the share of respondents who disapprove of Trump’s performance from the share who approve.
